metadata.scenario: A prospect wants to know if there are any introductory offers available for first-time visitors. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Betty Lou Smith, and I'm interested in learning about your services. Hi, Betty! It's great to hear from you. What specific services are you interested in? I'm looking for some information on introductory offers, especially for first-time visitors. I see. Currently, we don’t have any specific introductory offers for first-time clients. Oh, I see. I was hoping to find something to get started. I understand, Betty. While we don’t have introductory offers, we provide excellent rates for our services. Can you tell me about the pricing for your personal care assistance? Certainly! Our personal care assistance is priced between $28 and $35 per hour. That sounds reasonable. What does that service include? It includes help with bathing, dressing, grooming, and personal hygiene. That could be helpful. Do you also offer companionship services? Yes, we do! Companion care is available at $25 to $30 per hour. What does companion care entail? It includes social interaction, light housekeeping, meal preparation, and transportation assistance. That sounds perfect. I live alone, and some company would be nice. Definitely! We can provide consistent caregiver schedules to match your needs. That would work well for me. Would you like me to connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen? Yes, I think that would be helpful. I'll transfer your details to Lisa. She's excellent at caregiver matching! Thank you! Is there anything else I should know about your services? Just that we also offer skilled nursing and therapy services if you ever need them. I appreciate that information. You’re welcome! I’ll make sure Lisa follows up with you regarding care options. That sounds great, thank you for your help! My pleasure! Have a wonderful day, Betty. You too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
